technique_name: Create a detailed character background for a fantasy story.
description: The teenage girl, Nia, had grown up in a small rural farming village surrounded by the lush green fields of the countryside. Her parents were both farmers, working hard to make ends meet for the family. From a young age, Nia developed a strong affinity for nature and had an incredible talent for connecting with animals.
